title: Outcomes for kids treated at a health care facility for melatonin ingestion

source.name: Pediatric Melatonin Ingestions -- United States, 2012-2021 (MMWR)
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: Of the 27,795 pediatric melatonin cases treated at a health care facility 2012-2021: 71.6% were discharged same-day, 14.7% were hospitalized, and 1.0% required intensive care; two children died.
